observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 console standing vertically.
Two game controllers are visible: a black DualSense and a red DualSense.
The console is positioned on a wooden surface.
A watermark 'SOMMY SOMMY GADGETS' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The console appears clean in the photo, but 'neatly used' is subjective and cannot be confirmed remotely.
No game disc or case is visible in photo 0.
The watermark 'SOMMY SOMMY GADGETS' suggests this, but it is not a proof of ownership or stock.
The photo shows a clean exterior, but internal condition and ports cannot be seen.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may be a used or refurbished unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear of the console showing the 'Sony' and 'PlayStation' logos.

risks.risk: The console may be a digital-only version (PS5 Digital Edition) without a disc drive.
risks.proof: A photo of the console with the disc drive open or a photo of the disc drive itself.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or button failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers being used to navigate a menu or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the console's home screen showing a connected PSN account.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the console with the disc drive open.
Photo of the rear of the console showing the 'Sony' and 'PlayStation' logos.
Photo of the game disc or case for FIFA 2025.
Video of the console booting up and the controllers working.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PlayStation 5 from the photos. It can be priced at its worst case (used, Digital Edition, no disc drive, no game) until proof of the model and the presence of the game is provided.
